items.title: Dogecoin down 8%, bitcoin under $84,000 as Treasury yields hit highest level since 2007
items.snippet: A rebound in oil, the strongest U.S. business survey in five years and a poorly received five-year note sale pushed borrowing costs higher, with DOGE leading token losses.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC, DOGE за ключовими словами.

items.title: Kalshi says CFTC hasn’t contacted it over ‘unusual’ $5B trading activity
items.snippet: Kalshi said nearly $5 billion in similarly sized Ether perpetual trades reflected its liquidity incentive programs and rejected allegations that the activity was wash trading.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо ETH -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
